reviews.title: Excellent Service From Jabid
reviews.body:
I would like to express my sincere appreciation for the excellent service I received from Advisor Jabid.

Jabid was incredibly helpful, friendly, patient, attentive, and professional throughout the call. He listened carefully, understood the issues straight away, and resolved them efficiently. What impressed me most was that he also identified and offered to resolve an additional issue that I was unaware of. Had it gone unnoticed, it could potentially have caused further problems in the future.

The entire experience was made so much more positive by the way Jabid handled everything. He was polite, approachable, and genuinely lovely to deal with. His professionalism, attention to detail, and willingness to go above and beyond made me feel valued and reassured.

Thank you, Jabid, for providing such outstanding customer service. You are a real credit to your team!

reviews.title: My issue was resolved
reviews.body: My issue was resolved. I had been unable to send SMS for more than 7 days after activation. Support updated the SIM settings, I restarted the device, and the test SMS sent successfully. The agent then confirmed that outbound SMS will remain active and no further action is needed. Overall I’m satisfied with the final outcome. One improvement: it would be better to go straight to refreshing the SMS/roaming provisioning instead of repeating basic troubleshooting. Also, it would help if the agent clearly confirmed what settings were changed. Thank you.
